entries.title: Ezekiel 18:1
segments: ¶The word of the LORD came to me again, saying,

entries.title: Ezekiel 18:2
segments: "What do you mean when you use this proverb concerning the land of Israel, saying: 'The fathers have eaten sour grapes, And the children's teeth are set on edge'?

entries.title: Ezekiel 18:3
segments: "[As] I live," says the Lord GOD, "you shall no longer use this proverb in Israel.

entries.title: Ezekiel 18:4
segments: "Behold, all souls are Mine; The soul of the father As well as the soul of the son is Mine; The soul who sins shall die.

entries.title: Ezekiel 18:5
segments: But if a man is just And does what is lawful and right;

entries.title: Ezekiel 18:6
segments: If he has not eaten on the mountains, Nor lifted up his eyes to the idols of the house of Israel, Nor defiled his neighbor's wife, Nor approached a woman during her impurity;

entries.title: Ezekiel 18:7
segments: If he has not oppressed anyone, [But] has restored to the debtor his pledge; Has robbed no one by violence, [But] has given his bread to the hungry And covered the naked with clothing;

entries.title: Ezekiel 18:8
segments: If he has not exacted usury Nor taken any increase, [But] has withdrawn his hand from iniquity [And] executed true judgment between man and man;

entries.title: Ezekiel 18:9
segments: [If] he has walked in My statutes And kept My judgments faithfully-He [is] just; He shall surely live!" Says the Lord GOD.

entries.title: Ezekiel 18:10
segments: ¶"If he begets a son [who is] a robber Or a shedder of blood, [Who] does any of these [things]

entries.title: Ezekiel 18:11
segments: And does none of those [duties], But has eaten on the mountains Or defiled his neighbor's wife;

entries.title: Ezekiel 18:12
segments: If he has oppressed the poor and needy, Robbed by violence, Not restored the pledge, Lifted his eyes to the idols, [Or] committed abomination;

entries.title: Ezekiel 18:13
segments: If he has exacted usury Or taken increase-Shall he then live? He shall not live! If he has done any of these abominations, He shall surely die; His blood shall be upon him.

entries.title: Ezekiel 18:14
segments: "[If], however, he begets a son Who sees all the sins which his father has done, And considers but does not do likewise;

entries.title: Ezekiel 18:15
segments: [Who] has not eaten on the mountains, Nor lifted his eyes to the idols of the house of Israel, Nor defiled his neighbor's wife;

entries.title: Ezekiel 18:16
segments: Has not oppressed anyone, Nor withheld a pledge, Nor robbed by violence, [But] has given his bread to the hungry And covered the naked with clothing;

entries.title: Ezekiel 18:17
segments: [Who] has withdrawn his hand from the poor [And] not received usury or increase, But has executed My judgments And walked in My statutes-He shall not die for the iniquity of his father; He shall surely live!

entries.title: Ezekiel 18:18
segments: "[As for] his father, Because he cruelly oppressed, Robbed his brother by violence, And did what [is] not good among his people, Behold, he shall die for his iniquity.

entries.title: Ezekiel 18:19
segments: "Yet you say, 'Why should the son not bear the guilt of the father?' Because the son has done what is lawful and right, and has kept all My statutes and observed them, he shall surely live.

entries.title: Ezekiel 18:20
segments: "The soul who sins shall die. The son shall not bear the guilt of the father, nor the father bear the guilt of the son. The righteousness of the righteous shall be upon himself, and the wickedness of the wicked shall be upon himself.

entries.title: Ezekiel 18:21
segments: ¶"But if a wicked man turns from all his sins which he has committed, keeps all My statutes, and does what is lawful and right, he shall surely live; he shall not die.

entries.title: Ezekiel 18:22
segments: "None of the transgressions which he has committed shall be remembered against him; because of the righteousness which he has done, he shall live.

entries.title: Ezekiel 18:23
segments: "Do I have any pleasure at all that the wicked should die?" says the Lord GOD, "[and] not that he should turn from his ways and live?

entries.title: Ezekiel 18:24
segments: "But when a righteous man turns away from his righteousness and commits iniquity, and does according to all the abominations that the wicked [man] does, shall he live? All the righteousness which he has done shall not be remembered; because of the unfaithfulness of which he is guilty and the sin which he has committed, because of them he shall die.

entries.title: Ezekiel 18:25
segments: "Yet you say, 'The way of the Lord is not fair.' Hear now, O house of Israel, is it not My way which is fair, and your ways which are not fair?

entries.title: Ezekiel 18:26
segments: "When a righteous [man] turns away from his righteousness, commits iniquity, and dies in it, it is because of the iniquity which he has done that he dies.

entries.title: Ezekiel 18:27
segments: "Again, when a wicked [man] turns away from the wickedness which he committed, and does what is lawful and right, he preserves himself alive.

entries.title: Ezekiel 18:28
segments: "Because he considers and turns away from all the transgressions which he committed, he shall surely live; he shall not die.

entries.title: Ezekiel 18:29
segments: "Yet the house of Israel says, 'The way of the Lord is not fair.' O house of Israel, is it not My ways which are fair, and your ways which are not fair?

entries.title: Ezekiel 18:30
segments: ¶"Therefore I will judge you, O house of Israel, every one according to his ways," says the Lord GOD. "Repent, and turn from all your transgressions, so that iniquity will not be your ruin.

entries.title: Ezekiel 18:31
segments: "Cast away from you all the transgressions which you have committed, and get yourselves a new heart and a new spirit. For why should you die, O house of Israel?

entries.title: Ezekiel 18:32
segments: "For I have no pleasure in the death of one who dies," says the Lord GOD. "Therefore turn and live!"
